theme: A quiet Sunday before a travel day.
greeting: The week's board reset is behind you and the middle of the day was your own, Dan. The real push is tomorrow: a NYC appointment, then an evening flight south.

needsAttention.title: Lock the last Dubrovnik night
needsAttention.detail: The one room still open is Sat Sept 19 in Cavtat, near the airport, after the charter disembarks and before the 7:30 AM Sunday flight; the first three nights are already confirmed. It is the p1 on the Mike + Dan board, due today.

needsAttention.title: Neurology at HSS, arrive 1:45
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow's visit with Dr. Erin Manning at the HSS Belaire Building asks for a 1:45 PM arrival, and it sits right before the afternoon flight out of LaGuardia.

needsAttention.title: Pack for the flight to Florida
needsAttention.detail: DL 2433 leaves LGA at 6:30 PM tomorrow after the appointment, and the Kenwood stay in St. Petersburg begins on arrival, so anything you need packed is best done tonight.

recipe.title: Poached Peaches
recipe.why: High summer means peaches at their ripest, best gently poached before the season turns.

acts.line: One short review with Mike, and then the day loosened its grip.
Nothing on the calendar through the middle of the day, a genuinely open stretch.
A dinner out closes a quiet Sunday; the travel day is tomorrow.
